_about: Agenda Ahead Maryland (2026-11, gated): the 23 counties and Baltimore City (council or county commissioners, planning commission or M-NCPPC planning board, board of appeals) plus 17 Montgomery, Prince George's, Frederick, Anne Arundel and Washington County municipalities. Same row shape as towns_ma_all.json plus state, kind, zoning_power (own / county: Prince George's and Montgomery municipalities other than Laurel, Rockville, Gaithersburg, Poolesville and four small towns have no zoning power; the District Council zones), selection_group / selection_reason / selection_source. Built by `python3 experiments/va_md_wave.py discover --state MD`.
promotion_note: Promoted 2026-11-03: part of the production daily run and the site. Until then a test state, crawled only with --output-dir (experiments). Rows carry kind (county, city, town, township), county, coverage and, where they apply, zoning_power and coverage_county_body; build.py reads them.
evidence_rule: a board is automated only if its listing shows >=1 agenda/packet/notice dated within [today-120d, today+120d] and the first such document is fetchable under robots.txt
